'''HC-A1A Medium Cruiser''' were medium [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] used at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The HC-A1A Medium Cruiser had a very small and elongated upright main hull. It featured a pair of large wings originating at the top of the ship's bow, stretching all the way to the ship's rear, leaving a small space between the wings and the main hull. Two smaller wings sat at the bottom of the ship's bow. These cruisers were armed with three double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], two facing forward, one in the rear facing backward.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

==History==
[[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenaries]] used these ships in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] as freighters. They were often escorted by two [[HC-556 Light Cruiser]]s through the dangerous star system.<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
HC-A1A Medium Cruisers are starships in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion to [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. They are called "Mercenary Freighters" and can be found in the Kashyyyk system were several cruisers, always escorted by two HC-556 Light Cruisers fly on a set flight path through the system.<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
